ProjectionRace.scope: The existing editable-page replacement refusal and human-adoption ownership boundary, versus a rejected read-check-unconditional-replace proposal. Changed-body restore-follow calls the guard; automatic source-run policy also refuses unsupported projection replacement. A safe terminal refusal is not successful automatic update progress.
excluded: Explicit manual authoring writer protocol and all-writer guard coverage

UpdateCommit.scope: A bounded abstraction of one already-authorized selection write, two exact resource identities, two selected revisions and one existing session. Complete preparation precedes selection; an unknown original outcome cannot be invented from current equality. This is not a refinement proof of all source coordinator dispatches or a transaction across selection and readable projection.
excluded: Multiple writers or processes with different Stores

AuditRun.scope: Two surviving Skill roots, one orphan visible to the reverse census, one changed body, a one-Skill slice budget and up to two resumptions. The implemented coordinator performs initial/final registered-table census, durable task progress and a read-only semantic boundary; this finite model abstracts those operations and does not prove their HTTP accounting, SQLite durability or complete real-library coverage.
excluded: Arbitrary concurrent table changes or a global database snapshot
Unknown historical data absent from every retained index

implemented_boundary.scope: The read-only transport restricts descendant helpers, including legacy Notion requests, before scheduling. The real-code mutation gate removes this guard around an otherwise auto-adopting observer and requires the independent zero-write assertion to fail.

ImportCreate.scope: One explicitly enabled original create, two complete input objects and four abstract mutable stages: root allocation, Files/resources, metadata/selection and enablement. Preparation freezes approved bytes, the first dispatch rechecks the original local input, stage confirmation requires its durable original ACK, and explicit enablement follows complete verification. Lost-response absence cannot authorize replay; an acknowledged interrupted readback can be reconciled.
excluded: Arbitrary file counts, chunking and codec normalization
Concurrent human editing or a filesystem transaction during dispatch
Credential rotation, distributed writers or global exactly-once delivery

review_basis: Exact implementation commit and content hashes reviewed for the stated bounded abstractions. Hash equality binds a model review to these source files; it is not a full refinement proof. Public CLI, installed SDK, real providers, Notion, human UI edits and both physical hosts require their independent evidence. A model pass does not establish AH-681 completion.
